title: A page item that waits on a run or PR names it, and stays answered while it waits
why: Incident (owner, Nov 5 07:27-07:35 CST, q_max #1011, item 154): the page told him #1011 was green and current with main, and showed 154 as an ask to him. In fact main's browser run 41861801325 had ended RED on Nov 4 14:24 CDT and #1011 conflicted with main. The owner ruled it a fault of the build, not of the session.
note:
Nov 6 11:51 CST (coordinator audit, Explore sonnet; PR head reachable from origin/main): DONE, evidence #1257 on main.
Nov 5 08:56 CST (lane): draft PR #1257 (an item that waits on a run or PR stays answered), handed to batch runner 8. Lane session_013NEJL1ddAMtjFuBZJAddJ1, started Nov 5 07:36 CST (coordinator). Cause 1 (read, waiting-page SKILL.md): 'Route and close' has no state for an answered item that waits on outside work. Step 2 closes the item and deletes answers/<id>; step 4 rewrites it and deletes the answer. 154 was closed and then reopened 'until the run ends' (09:52 CST Nov 4) with its answer gone. The page counts an open item with no answers/<id> as an owner ask (page.html isSunk, savedOf) and ignores lastAnswer, so 154 read as his to-do. The coordinator rule P4 (keep the answer until the PR merges) lives in no record. Cause 2 (read): an item names what it waits on only in free text (lane, reply), and the skill says 'no timer, no watcher', so nothing tells the writer when that run ends, and no check flags a Based on (measured) line that a finished run made false. Fix, one lane, waiting-page only: (a) an item field `waits` ({repo, run | pr}); while it is set, the page counts the item as answered from lastAnswer, and Route and close keeps the answer until the wait ends; (b) a script, run on demand at each writer wake inside the existing stale_pages pass (no timer, no new process), reads GitHub for each `waits` and prints the items whose run ended or PR merged, so the writer rewrites or closes them in that wake; (c) the record for P4 moves into the skill. Red first: item 154's exact history (close, reopen, answer deleted) must show as an owner ask on today's page and as answered after the fix. Needs no answer.
